rows.description: Which Golden LC extract vintage to load from $GOLDEN_LOCATION (e.g. v_2C, v_2A1).
Region preset. Drives currency_filter / region_filter / convert_to_USD / fama_factor_region below.
Workbook holding the Japanese monthly risk-free rate; read only on the Japan JPY path.

Append Ken French's momentum factor to both factor specifications (FF3 + Mom = Carhart 4-factor, FF5 + Mom = 6-factor). Europe, United_States and Developed only; any other region raises in 05_load_fama_french.

Which signal design the run sorts on: it picks categories_dict and lc_signals, and for 'total_material_minus_immaterial' also the signal NUMERATOR (material__total - immaterial__total, signed, with signal_1 its exact negation), leaving signal_type to pick the denominator.
First calendar year of the return / universe window.
Last calendar year. Overridden by esg_choice (refinitiv or msci -> 2024, s&p -> 2022).
'active_only' keeps Compustat secstat=='A' (the frozen behaviour); 'all_firms_even_delisted' keeps inactive securities, so a delisted name retains its full price history.
Number of buckets in the univariate quantile sort (7 = septiles).

How a firm sitting exactly ON a cutpoint is bucketed. 'half_open' (frozen) sends a tie block to the bucket below; 'closed' gives it to both adjacent buckets, making complementary-signal mirrors exact at the cost of the buckets no longer partitioning the universe.

How each bucket's return is weighted across holdings. 'equal' (frozen) gives every name 1/n; 'mktcap' weights by last_mktcap at the formation month, capped per name at max_portfolio_weight_if_portfolio_weighting_equal.

Single-name ceiling under portfolio_weighting='mktcap' (0.10 = 10%); ignored under 'equal'. Excess is redistributed pro-rata by market cap and re-checked, iteratively. Where n x cap <= 1 no capped vector exists and the bucket falls back to equal weight.
ESG provider merged into the universe: none / refinitiv / msci / s&p. Also picks which Process runs at merge_esg_provider.
Sort the whole ESG universe on the provider score alone, with no LC signals. Requires a provider.
Gate for the esg_signal_corr node's correlation output.
Correlation method used there (pearson / spearman / kendall).
Minimum issues per sort cell before prepare_panel collapses it into one composite stage.
Currency of the FF factor set. Consulted only when region_analysis='Japan' (05_load_fama_french).
In the esg_full_universe run only: exclude real estate.
In the esg_full_universe run only: exclude utilities.
Re-download GICS sector codes instead of using the cached file.
Denominator for signal_i: 'Sum_All_Signals' or 'Sum_All_Initiatives' (02_derive_signals).

'weights' = signal_i is the group's share of sum_activities; 'counts' = the raw initiative total, and signal names gain a _counts suffix. Under action_characterization='total_material_minus_immaterial' the numerator is fixed (a count difference) and signal_type picks only the denominator: 'weights' = none, 'per_revenue' = sale_usd, 'counts' refused.
Trim fraction applied to the signal tails when use_alpha_bound is on.
Per-tail fraction of each signal CLIPPED (not dropped) within its rfyear. 0 = off. Rank-preserving, so it moves results only via the standardisation, not the sort.
Which universe size screen runs: 'percent_total_mcap' (per currency-MONTH, share of aggregate cap VALUE) or 'percent_stocks' (per currency-YEAR, share of listing COUNT plus an absolute floor).
percent_total_mcap only: fraction of each currency-month's total cap to retain. 0.95 is a share of value, so it discards roughly 65% of listings.
percent_stocks only: fraction of listings BY COUNT eligible for dropping (0.01 = 1%). Must be in [0,1]; a listing is dropped only if it is also below the floor.
percent_stocks only: absolute cap floor in the mktcap currency. Being absolute, it makes that screen single-currency only.
Merge Compustat accounting items. Provenance only -- not read by any node.
Inner-join the SASB materiality workbook on (gvkey, rfyear). CHANGES THE SAMPLE -- the workbook stops at rfyear 2022.
SASB workbook vintage (1 or 2). Only v2 carries the per-SDG breakdown columns.
Which SDG (1-17) action_characterization='Materiality_single_SDG' sorts on, material vs immaterial. None for every other characterization.
Industry granularity the sort is taken within (0, 1 or 2).
Japan fiscal-year alignment: the month that splits fiscal year Y-2 from Y-1.
Which sample filters run: 'all' (min fyears + suspicious gvkeys + min initiatives), 'suspicious_only' (filter 2 alone), or 'none'.
Filter 1: minimum distinct fiscal years a firm must have to stay in the sample.
Filter 3: minimum initiatives an Annual Report row must carry. (Key spelling is as in the config.)
Filter 2: drop the hand-listed suspicious gvkeys.
Exclude real estate from the LC sample.
Exclude financials from the LC sample.
Exclude utilities from the LC sample.
Exclude health care from the LC sample.
Restrict the sample to fashion firms. (Key spelling is as in the config.)
Which MSCI score column to merge ('weighted' or 'industry').
Whether the alpha_bound trim runs at all.
Emit the sample-portfolio diagnostic from build_analyse_portfolios.
Coverage plots. Provenance only -- not read by any node (that plot is notebook-era, in functions/extra_functions/plot_coverage.py).
Gate for the esg_coverage node, and for the pre-filter LC snapshot it needs from this node.
Gate for the mktcap_filter_audit node, which replays the size screen per currency-month.
Gate for the sample_funnel_audit node, which reports rows in / out at each filter.

Gate for the material-initiative decomposition in build_analyse_portfolios: the computation, these widgets AND the run's initiative_decomposition.pdf. Bands split the SIGNAL'S NUMERATOR (what signal_0 counted), not all 17 SDGs. Off by default -- it is the most expensive audit here.
Include every signal in the cumulative / risk tables. Provenance only -- not read by any node.
Derived from region_analysis: which FF factor files to load. BOTH are loaded per run -- *_3_Factors.csv for FF3 and *_5_Factors.csv for FF5 -- so every run reports both alpha specifications.
Derived from region_analysis: currencies kept in the universe.
Derived from region_analysis: whether returns and caps are converted to USD.
Derived from region_analysis: Compustat region names kept.
Derived from region_analysis: whether that region filter is applied at all.
Derived from action_characterization: LC category column -> signal index.
Derived from action_characterization: signal_i -> human-readable name (with the _counts suffix when signal_type='counts').
Derived: which tail the LC sorts report. Provenance only -- not read by any node.
Derived: per-signal direction of the long-short leg.
Derived: the provider ESG score treated as an extra sortable signal ({} when esg_choice='none').
Derived: the (signal, bucket) pairs to analyse. Provenance only -- 07_build_analyse_portfolios rebuilds this list locally instead of reading it.
